replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Absolutely. Math gives me anxiety because I find it confusing and not intuitive. My high neuroticism might make this worse. I prefer subjects that engage my creativity, like art.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Not really. I avoid math as much as possible. When I had to review some stats for work, I used an AI calculator, but it didn't help—math still overwhelmed me.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, write it as ax² + bx + c = 0. Then, check if factoring works. If not, use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(b²-4ac)] / (2a). Plug in numbers slowly and double-check.

First, find the first derivative f'(x). Set it to zero and solve for x to find critical points. Then check the second derivative f''(x) at those points. If f''(x) > 0, it's a minimum; if < 0, it's a maximum.
